additional_info.subject: ID0457443-DC/Si-D/CH-[RVP / T7 170004960] Insufficient charging power CRM:03056000289
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael,
I hope that You are well!
According to our analysis as you can see in the following sequence:
"2025-10-23T07:39:27.825636+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4129] [DCC] |2025-10-23T07:33:51|DC1: |EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=120|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=166|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=119.5|EVSE_NowCur[A]=165|EVSE_NowVol[V]=724.4|EV_TarCur[A]=165|EV_TarVol[V]=789|EV_SOC[%]=87|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=394|Pilot=4"
When the car is already charged with 87%, he will get the Power of 120kW and not the 400kW.
I hope that this clarifies this issue and we can close the ticket.
Best Regards,
Marcelo Küster

additional_info.subject: Re: ID0457443-DC/Si-D/CH-[RVP / T7 170004960] Insufficient charging power CRM:03056000289
additional_info.body:
Dear Marcelo Küster,
Thank you for your analysis. However, your conclusion is unfortunately incorrect. The charger consistently delivers only 120 kW, regardless of the truck model or its battery percentage.
For example, our records show:
* **Charger Serial Number 170004960:**
* **4956057 GiezAG17594:** 91.59 kWh charged from 09:58:36 to 10:45:09 on 10/24/2025 (Scania Battery 52%, Max Power 120 kWh)
* **4952131 FiscGR62000:** 60.97 kWh charged from 10:39:38 to 11:10:51 on 10/23/2025 (Volvo, Battery 38%, Max Power 120 kWh)
We ordered a 400 kW charging stall and expect this level of performance. We request you to re-examine the data thoroughly, as this issue is already causing a significant financial impact.
Please ensure coordination with the local technical team as the charger was inspected earlier today.
Many thanks
Best regards,
Michael
----
